registered_after: completed AR2 C diagnostic; before any proxy fits or validation risk
inputs: captured native V1 after Q1, before FFN0; no H/V2/test target enters the predictor
label: training donor C scores from frozen AR2 checkpoints
hyperparameter_selection: four training-only folds by observed latent time modulo4; normalized C-score MSE
input_normalization: training channel mean, one global centered RMS; kernel dot divided by5120
kernel_normalization: training mean kernel diagonal, weighted centering; n*lambda ridge
support: 216 original groups64; top108, stable group-ID tie break
gain: policy-specific bias-free gain fit only on donor using its predicted supports
primary_gate: proxy<=0.8 random and <=0.9 C_static and <=1.1 true C_dynamic; >=3/4 with both seeds/steps, independently for task0/task6
precision: FP64 kernel fit/prediction diagnostic; native CPU BF16 projection primary, matched FP32 control
deployment_status: unmeasured; row-wise support diagnosis does not validate a tile-shared or sparse CUDA implementation
